observed_result: The eight kinds are declared, validated, applied and reported, on both the learning individual and the native runner, and a plan that does not declare itself an experiment changes nothing. (1) Declaration and the eight validation rules (TestInterventionPlanValidate, 44 sub-cases): rule 1 refuses an unauthorized plan or a blank reason with ErrInterventionNotAuthorized via errors.Is; rule 2 refuses empty items and an unknown kind ("ablate"); rule 3 refuses an empty interval and NaN/Inf value; rule 4 refuses empty, duplicate, descending, out-of-range and negative node targets and force_spike on a non-spiking core; rule 5 refuses channel kinds without chemistry and out-of-range/negative channels and a negative fix value; rule 6 refuses swap_regions with fewer than two regions, identical or out-of-range regions; rule 7 refuses shuffle_delays with no positive delay and out-of-range/duplicate edge indices; rule 8 refuses two same-kind items that overlap in time on the same target while allowing overlap on different targets, adjacent intervals and different kinds. TestInterventionShapeFromIndividual derives the shape from fixture configs: continuous without chemistry (Nodes 2, no spike, 0 channels, 0 edges), with chemistry (1 channel, 1 region), plain LIF (spiking, 0 channels) and a one-edge LIF with delay 2 (Edges 1, MaxDelay 2). assumption_statement: Interventions are an authorized experiment mode, not an inference API: Advance, AdvanceGated and simulate run expose no parameter that can overwrite a voltage, Intervene requires Authorized = true and a non-blank Reason and otherwise returns ErrInterventionNotAuthorized, and a simulate protocol without an interventions block hashes exactly as it did before the field existed. Every delta is an L2 distance, and for the learning path it is computed by restoring an in-silico twin from the same starting snapshot and advancing it without the plan on the same input; the runner compares against the same protocol with the block removed. Channel, region and delay-shuffle parameters (release rates, fixed concentrations, regions, shuffle seed) are engineering declarations of the fixture, not measurements, and fix_concentration is a per-call declaration that is never written back into stored parameters. The hand constants (k = exp(-1), alpha = 1 - k, tanh(0.25), 2*exp(-0.5), the removal and fix ConcentrationDelta literals) are the closed forms of the fixture dynamics with tau = dt = 1.
limitations: Fixture scale only: one to three neurons, one channel, four rows or fewer in most calls, no whole-brain, real-data, cross-platform or performance run.

The native runner has no chemistry, regions or delayed edges, so only the three node kinds (clamp_voltage, force_spike, silence) are supported there; block_channel, fix_concentration, remove_channel, swap_regions and shuffle_delays are refused on simulate (TestUnsupportedKindRejected covers block_channel only).

The runner counts [Start, End) per Run call, not as global trajectory steps: AppliedSteps is the overlap of the declared window with the rows of that one call (overlapSteps clamps to [0, steps)); the mapping between a multi-Run intervention window and global steps is not tested.
TaskDelta (task-result difference, specification 11.8) is not implemented: no current test produces a non-nil TaskDelta; only activity, plastic, base-parameter and concentration deltas are measured.
Node interventions are refused on a mixed core ("not implemented yet"): the log only proves the refusal and that nothing changes, not a clamp on a mixed core itself.

Real data were not run. The free-inference constraint is shown at the API level (no overwrite parameter, unauthorized refusal, unchanged protocol hash) on fixture graphs; no whole-brain protocol has been executed with an interventions block.
shuffle_delays is verified on one permutation only (seed 7, [1 2] to [2 1]); the permutation's statistical properties (a preserved set of positive delays, no duplicates) have no test of their own.

swap_regions is value-neutral on this stage's fixture because one channel releases the same rate into every region (ConcentrationDelta 0); per-region sources that would make the swap observable are a later decision.
